Privacidad, eliminación de cuentas y licencias actualizadas.

notes.en:

Updated streaming and multimedia components.
Removed integrated translation features.
PSP ATRAC audio is temporarily disabled; some encrypted Nintendo DS and PSP ROMs are not supported.
